note: Hand-picked recent AI reporting from large, reputable newsrooms, links verified. Source mix is limited by access tooling: WSJ, Reuters, FT and Bloomberg are blocked from automated browsing, so the openable/verified set skews CNBC, AP (wire) and MIT Technology Review. The updater (8×/day) can broaden sources over time.

items.title: The U.S. wants Asia to use its AI — but China dominates cheaper models
items.blurb: Washington pushes a full US chips-to-models stack in Asia while cheaper Chinese open models win price-sensitive buyers.

items.title: Samsung Electronics second-quarter operating profit beats estimates on soaring AI chip demand
items.blurb: Record memory earnings on AI server demand, cutting against this week's thesis that AI infrastructure spending is peaking.

items.title: AI investor Leopold Aschenbrenner forced to unwind all public stock positions after steep losses
items.blurb: Situational Awareness, a roughly $20B AI-focused fund, sold its entire public book to Citadel after losses on AI infrastructure.

items.title: AI labs face prisoner's dilemma as momentum grows for safety slowdown
items.blurb: Over 1,100 frontier-lab employees signed a letter asking Washington to build tools to deliberately pace AI development.

items.title: China threatens retaliation against U.S. humanoid robot ban, says it 'severely damages' relations
items.blurb: Beijing responds to FCC restrictions on foreign-made humanoid and quadruped robots, escalating the US-China hardware split.

items.title: OpenAI cuts prices for two of its GPT-5.6 AI models as companies grow sensitive to costs
items.blurb: Luna falls 80% to $0.20/$1.20 per million tokens, Terra 20% to $2/$12, three weeks after launch.

items.title: Meta sinks 8%, continuing record losing streak, while Microsoft jumps 15% as AI trade splits
items.blurb: Investors reward Azure's 43% growth and punish Meta's AI capex, splitting the megacap AI trade.

items.title: Scale AI hires Francis deSouza, former Google Cloud executive as new CEO
items.blurb: Leadership change at the largest AI data-labeling vendor, a key supplier to frontier training runs.

items.title: Amazon's AWS posts fastest growth since 2021, citing AI and chip demand
items.blurb: AWS revenue rose 37% to $42.2B; AI and chip lines each pass $25B annualized as capex guidance hits $220B.

items.title: Amazon revenue soars as AI investments pay off
items.blurb: Triple-digit growth in AWS AI and chip businesses gives the AI-capex trade its clearest payoff datapoint this quarter.

items.title: AI-focused hedge fund sells all of its stocks
items.blurb: Situational Awareness sold its entire public equity book to Citadel after AI-infrastructure losses, signaling forced deleveraging.

items.title: 'This is a clearing event' — Cramer says forced selling may signal a bottom for AI trade
items.blurb: Argues leveraged-fund unwinding is stabilizing AI equities after chip stocks shed over $1 trillion this week.

items.title: SK Hynix shares tank as exponential earnings growth fails to satisfy AI-charged expectations
items.blurb: Revenue up 257% and profit up 557% still missed supercharged expectations; shares fell over 15%.

items.title: Asian technology stocks extend sell-off with SoftBank down 10% as AI plays take a hit
items.blurb: Memory and AI-linked names slide again; South Korea's Kospi now roughly 45% below its June high.

items.title: The Download: a chip talent battle, and deflating AI hype
items.blurb: SK Hynix pays a $476,000 per-employee bonus off HBM profits, pulling engineers away from Samsung.

items.title: The AI Hype Index: Unsexy AI
items.blurb: Periodic tally separating demonstrated capability from marketing, covering robotics, smart glasses and Big Tech emissions.

items.title: Anthropic is the world's most valuable startup — and its most isolated AI leader
items.blurb: Anthropic alone refused Nvidia's open-weight letter while leading benchmarks at a $965B valuation and preparing an IPO.

items.title: Meta's stock plunges almost 10% on disappointing guidance, dwindling free cash flow
items.blurb: Meta lifted 2026 capex guidance to $130-145B as expenses jumped 55% and profit fell 14%, spooking investors.

items.title: Microsoft aces earnings call, while Meta frustration grows: 'Do we just need to be a bit more patient?'
items.blurb: Microsoft's capex rose 70% to $41B but Azure strength reassured markets; Meta's same spending drew punishment.

items.title: Meta and Microsoft report ballooning AI expenses: What to know

items.title: Sam Altman to meet with White House's Wiles this week ahead of AI framework deadline
items.blurb: Trump's June AI order sets an Aug 1 deadline for a classified cyber-capability benchmarking process for frontier models.

items.title: OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar tells employees that annualized revenue in July topped all of Q2
items.blurb: OpenAI credits the GPT-5.6 series, ChatGPT Work and Codex for a single month outrunning an entire prior quarter.

items.title: OpenAI launches free AI access program for academic researchers
items.blurb: Selected researchers get frontier models and tools through 2027, starting near 10,000 users and scaling toward 100,000.
